source: 官方规格书一手资料（优先级高于 term bank 锚点）：Product Presentation/Wave Solder Series/ 下 S-WS450A 2018.pdf、S-WS450C.pdf、SWS450M (Big board).pdf

fields.ONE_LINER: 450 mm PCB wave soldering - 4 preheat zones, dual wave, lead-free, 3-5 kW running power.
fields.NARRATIVE: Flux first, then four preheat zones bring the board up before it meets the dual wave. The chip wave breaks into shadowed joints, the main wave fills them. Boards exit through forced cooling, ready for the next station.
fields.SPEC_01: 01  PCB WIDTH                50-450 mm, manually or motorised adjustable
fields.SPEC_02: 02  PREHEAT                  4 zones / 1800 mm, room temp to 250 C, PID + SSR
fields.SPEC_03: 03  SOLDER POT               450 kg (A/C) or 480 kg (M), +/-1-2 C, up to 350 C
fields.SPEC_04: 04  WAVE SYSTEM              Dual wave, 0-15 mm (C) / 0-18 mm (M), inverter driven
fields.SPEC_06: 06  FLUX                     10-100 ml/min, stepper nozzle, closed-loop speed control
fields.SPEC_07: 07  POWER / WEIGHT           3P5W 380 V, max 22 kW start, approx. 3-5 kW running, approx. 1500 kg
fields.PAIRING: SUL460 Magazine Unloader - keeps the wave exit clear so the line never waits on an operator
fields.HERO_MEDIA: S-WS450 3/4-view cut-out render, or a muted looping MP4 of the dual wave
fields.MARQUEE_MEDIA: solder wave close-up / board exiting the wave / flux sprayer / preheat zone / SUL460 unloading / HMI screen / dross removal

params_confirmed: PCB width 50-450 mm (A/C/M 三份规格书一致)
conveyor height 750 +/- 50 mm; incline 3-7 deg (A 标 4-7 deg)
conveyor speed 0-2000 mm/min (A) / 1500-1800 mm/min typical welding (C/M)
preheat 4 zones, 1800 mm (A/M) / 2000 mm (C), room temp to 250 C, PID + SSR
solder pot temp up to 350 C (A/C) / 300 C (M), control precision +/-1-2 C
dual wave (wave quantity 2); wave height 0-15 mm (C) / 0-18 mm (M)
flux flow 10-100 ml/min, stepper motor + ST-6 / A-100 nozzle
power 3P5W 380 V; start max 22 kW; running approx. 3-5 kW (C/M), 10 kW operation consumption (A)
weight approx. 1500 kg; footprint L4500 x W1400 x H1650 mm (A/C), 3900 x 1600 x 1730 mm (M)
finger: double hook claw standard, titanium ball-structure finger option
dross 1.5 kg / 10 h dual wave (SWS450M 内部对比测试)
service: 1-year warranty, on-site installation, L1-L3 training, 7x24 support, lifetime free software upgrade
compliance: CE / CCC / UL (A 规格书)
params_withheld: 氮气选配：仅 S-WS450C 规格书给出 10-25 m3/h、可达 1000 PPM；A/M 未标注，页面统一写 Optional / On request
M 规格表 preheat power 8 kW 与正文 22 kW 冲突 —— 页面取规格表 8 kW，正文 22 kW 不引用
M 规格表 Solder pot temp. accuracy 出现 +/-10 与 +/-1-2 C 两处不一致 —— 取 +/-1-2 C（与 A/C 一致）
notes: 波峰焊主力机型，三份官方 PDF 覆盖 A / C / M 三个变体（M 为大板方案）。页面以 S-WS450 系列为主体，用变体对照表呈现差异。SUL460 为强制配套，页面上必须出现。所有数值均出自规格书，未确认项写 On request。
